sing.name: Foal song
sing.note: Calm a wild kith, or steady Ash

guard.name: Guard
guard.note: Take hits for an ally this round

call.name: Call Ash
call.note: He charges the whole front line

fin.knife.name: Opening
fin.knife.note: Finisher: one exact cut where the guard is weakest

fin.sabre.name: Drill Line
fin.sabre.note: Finisher: cuts along the whole front line

fin.bow.name: Called Shot
fin.bow.note: Finisher: one arrow, aimed for as long as it takes

fin.spear.note: Finisher: through the front, into whoever stands behind

fin.lance.note: Finisher: rides down the front line

fin.shield.note: Finisher: shoves the front line back and shakes their nerve

fin.rope.name: Bolas

fin.tools.name: Rigged Fall

art.brineback.name: Crush

art.gloamer.name: Glare
art.gloamer.note: Kith art: a flash that dazzles every foe

art.bellower.name: Bellow
art.bellower.note: Kith art: a roar that breaks nerve along the front

art.kith.name: Kith Strike
art.kith.note: Kith art: your kith strikes with everything it has
